title: Form W-2 box 2 federal income tax withheld statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 2 of a Form W-2 furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form W-2 box 2 only; it says nothing about box 1 wages (a separate family, separately closed) or any other box. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0. A box-1 W-2 statement recorded without a matching box-2 finding is not cross-checked against this family -- the same present-source-skips-closure behavior box 1's own family already has (P0 Sec. 3; Track 1 contract item 2).
